accountNotes: Fresh account, no content cleared as of 2026-09-17. Unusually strong champion pool for a new account (1 Mythical + 7 Legendary), but zero gear, levels, or mastery scrolls. Bottleneck is resources, not champions.

champions.name: Starsage Galathir
champions.notes: Best champion owned. Deferred to day 45-60: most expensive to level, kit is insurance not acceleration, and data is thin. Build for RESISTANCE not Accuracy - passive converts RES to ACC.

champions.name: Ninja
champions.notes: Tyler 'Ninja' Blevins collab, NOT Nintendo Switch. Self-sufficient boss killer - nearly every skill has a 'vs Boss' clause. Applies HP Burn, so feeds Rathalos's passive.

champions.name: Artak
champions.notes: NOT Banner Lords. HP-scaling so forgiving with bad gear. ONLY source of AoE HP Burn - the win condition at Spider 21-25 and the enabler for Rathalos. Solos Ice Golem Hard 5 eventually.

champions.name: Turvold
champions.notes: S-tier Clan Boss but explicitly gated behind having a buff-support team. A3 scales with number of buffs ON him. Defer to endgame CB team. Warmaster vs Giant Slayer UNRESOLVED - test before spending scrolls.

champions.name: Rathalos Blademaster
champions.notes: Monster Hunter collab, now unobtainable. A2 ignores 100% of boss DEF; A1 Dec DEF unresistable vs bosses. Needs exactly 12 Legendary Tomes for a clean full max. Pair with Artak for the HP Burn passive.

champions.name: Gnishak Verminlord
champions.notes: Highest solo ceiling on the roster: Dragon 25, Ice Golem 25, Faction Wars, Doom Tower bosses. Bombs double-damage vs 200k+ MAX HP targets. Needs Regeneration/Bolster sustain first. 3-hit A1 = Giant Slayer.

champions.name: Ultimate Deathknight
champions.notes: Infrastructure champion. +30% DEF aura, AoE 50% Dec ATK at 80%, Shield + Continuous Heal, redirects a hit off any ally. Later solos Dragon 25 / Ice Golem 25 with Toxic. Skill NAMES are uncertain; effects corroborated.

champions.name: Hurndig
champions.notes: AoE 60% Dec DEF + 50% Dec ACC on A2. Can run as a cheap Perception debuffer long before nuker gear exists. Also a Nightmare campaign solo farmer. PICK A LANE - he cannot do both.

champions.name: Godseeker Aniri
champions.notes: Revive with FULL cooldown reset - near-unique. Void affinity. 14 books to max but only A2 matters. Permanent endgame value, Hydra staple. Does nothing for early clear speed.

champions.name: Skullcrown
champions.notes: AoE A1 (rare and valuable) + free Weaken + self-Unkillable. Good wave clearer and Arena nuker, no boss utility. Reported base SPD 196 is implausible and should be ignored. From Beyond passive needs Sinesha (not owned).

champions.name: Tagoar
champions.notes: AoE Increase SPD on a 3-turn cooldown - the tool that unlocks 2:1 Clan Boss speed tunes. Plus mass revive, AoE Shield, AoE heal, Increase DEF on A1, +25% HP aura. Long-lived into endgame.

champions.name: Uugo
champions.notes: Best Epic on the roster. A2 lands 60% AoE Dec DEF AND AoE Block Buffs on one skill. Booked A2 goes to 100% chance / 3-turn cooldown - the #1 Epic Tome target. Needs real ACC to function.

champions.name: Alure
champions.notes: NOT Dark Elves. DO NOT BOOK HER - booking reduces A1 usage and A1 is her entire value. 3 hits x 25% TM strip on crit. 100% C.RATE mandatory. Needs 300+ ACC. Endgame Fire Knight 21-25 speed-run specialist.

champions.name: Morag Bronzelock
champions.notes: DEF is her attack stat (1.85x and 3.9x DEF multipliers) - one gear pool serves offence and defence, hugely gear-efficient. Team-wide Strengthen is rare. No aura. Spirit affinity = advantaged at Dragon 25.

champions.name: High Khatun
champions.notes: Correct spelling is High Khatun. +19% ally SPD aura in ALL battles - keep her at low level purely as an aura leader even if not built. Engine of the early 2:1 CB tune. Endgame relevance limited.

champions.name: Fenax
champions.notes: RESEARCH INCOMPLETE. Known: 60% single-target Dec DEF, 30% Dec SPD, AoE Block Buffs (75% vs 80% conflict), AoE Block Active Skills, Block Revive on A1 that needs NO Accuracy. The no-ACC Block Revive maps directly onto Ice Golem's Frigid Vengeance. Verify in-game before any investment.

champions.name: Kael
champions.notes: BUILD FIRST. The only champion who generates resources rather than consuming them. Lifesteal set, HP/DEF/SPD/ACC (survivability not damage). 800 Gems for masteries. Permanent niche in Rare-restricted Doom Tower Secret Rooms.

champions.name: Apothecary
champions.notes: Cheapest large power gain on the roster: 10 Rare Tomes for a full max. Heal scales off the ALLY's MAX HP so he works while under-geared. GIANT SLAYER not Warmaster (3-hit A1). Triple Speed sets, 100% C.RATE for Critical Heals.

knownGaps: No team-wide Unkillable or Block Damage - blocks standard endgame Clan Boss templates
No team-wide Increase ATK (only Turvold self-buffs) - mitigate with DEF-scaling Ice Golem teams
Fire Knight multi-hit coverage is tight: Apothecary + Alure + Gnishak + Morag = 11 hits, needs a 5th
Affinity imbalance: Magic x9, Force x4, Void x3, Spirit x2. Magic is disadvantaged at Dragon 25 (Force)
chaseList: Team-wide Unkillable or Block Damage provider (highest value)
More multi-hit A1 champions (fixes Fire Knight)
Spirit and Force champions (rebalance a Magic-heavy roster)
